data.content:
I drafted and sent four disputes, worth $94.50 in total. One case is waiting on a ticket photo from you, and several others I skipped or didn't review.

**Sent**

| Case | Amount | Win chance | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| UE-tf06f | $31.20 | 90% (strong) | The ticket doesn't list Butter Chicken. The order was ready at 18:47 and picked up at 18:50. |
| UE-tf07g | $26.80 | 75% (moderate) | The ticket lists Chicken Tikka. It was ready at 13:32 and picked up at 13:38. |
| UE-tf02b | $21.50 | 75% (moderate) | The ticket lists Lamb Biryani. It was ready at 19:22 and picked up at 19:26. |
| UE-tf03c | $15.00 | 87% (moderate) | The ticket lists Garlic Naan. It was ready at 20:33 and picked up at 20:36. The same customer account made 3 claims this period, and the dispute states that as a count only. |

- **Limits of the evidence:** In the three moderate cases, the evidence doesn't show what was in the bag at handoff. The drafts say so.
- **No similar history:** I found no past Uber Eats disputes with the same evidence pattern, so these chances come only from this run's checks. Past DoorDash cases with a ticket and prompt handoff won 2 of 3. The one loss involved a side item that wasn't itemised on the ticket. That history is a different platform, so treat it loosely.

**Weak, needs something from you**
- **UE-tf01a ($52.00, 30%):** This is the largest deduction, but I found no order ticket for it. Please send a photo of the ticket for this order. I'll re-check the case once I have it.

**Skipped or not reviewed**
- **Recommended skips:**
  - UE-tf08h ($9.00): low value.
  - UE-tf09i ($14.00): 15% win chance.
  - UE-tf00z ($0.00): its deadline has already passed.
- **Not reviewed:** UE-tf04d ($18.25, 45%) and UE-tf05e ($12.75, 55%) were outside the top 5, so I didn't check evidence for them. I can run them next if you want.

**Next deadline:** 2026-12-12, in 28 days. This applies to every open case, including UE-tf01a.

I saved the case notes in `/plan.md`.
